name: Allergy testing
summary: How expats arrange allergy testing in Singapore — skin prick vs blood panels, paediatric pathways, and what results do (and do not) change at home.
body:
Allergy clinics use skin prick tests, specific IgE blood panels, and sometimes challenge testing. Results guide avoidance and treatment plans, but they are not a free pass to over-restrict diets without clinician advice.

## Decision points
- Skin prick vs blood test timing (antihistamine washout)
- Food vs environmental allergen panels
- Paediatric vs adult clinic pathways
- Immunotherapy eligibility after confirmed allergy
- Insurance cover for specialist consults and panels

Bring a symptom diary and ingredient photos from flares.

## How to choose
Prefer clinicians who explain false positives and do not sell huge panel packages without history. Ask about anaphylaxis action plans. Confirm follow-up for interpreting borderline results.

## Practical tip
Pause antihistamines only as instructed before skin testing — do not freestyle the washout from a forum post.
